name: codestar-connections
description: AWS CodeStar Connections This Amazon Web Services CodeStar Connections API Reference provides descriptions and usage examples of the operations and data types for the Amazon Web Services CodeStar Connections API.

subcommands.name: create-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a connection that can then be given to other Amazon Web Services services like CodePipeline so that it can access third-party code repositories.

options.name: --provider-type
options.description: The name of the external provider where your third-party code repository is configured

options.name: --connection-name
options.description: The name of the connection to be created

options.name: --tags
options.description: The key-value pair to use when tagging the resource

options.name: --host-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the host associated with the connection to be created

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: create-sync-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a sync configuration which allows Amazon Web Services to sync content from a Git repository to update a specified Amazon Web Services resource.

options.name: --branch
options.description: The branch in the repository from which changes will be synced

options.name: --config-file
options.description: The file name of the configuration file that manages syncing between the connection and the repository.

options.name: --repository-link-id
options.description: The ID of the repository link created for the connection.

options.name: --resource-name
options.description: The name of the Amazon Web Services resource (for example, a CloudFormation stack in the case of CFN_STACK_SYNC) that will be synchronized from the linked repository

options.name: --role-arn
options.description: The ARN of the IAM role that grants permission for Amazon Web Services to use Git sync to update a given Amazon Web Services resource on your behalf

options.name: --sync-type
options.description: The type of sync configuration

options.name: --publish-deployment-status
options.description: Whether to enable or disable publishing of deployment status to source providers

options.name: --trigger-resource-update-on
options.description: When to trigger Git sync to begin the stack update

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
